title: One malformed bag entry in localStorage crashes every page (empty shop grid, blank checkout)
detail: lines() reads it.slug without checking each entry is an object. Repro: localStorage mc.bag.v1='[null]' -> pageerror "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'slug')"; home grid renders 0 of 12 cards, checkout renders no form. It persists, so the shop stays broken for that visitor until they clear site data. Fix: in read() keep only plain objects with string slug/format (list.filter(x => x && typeof x === 'object' && typeof x.slug === 'string')), and merge duplicate slug:format keys; add a unit test seeding [null], {}, and duplicate keys.

title: Bag silently does nothing when localStorage.setItem throws but getItem works (quota/locked storage)
detail: write() stores to memory on setItem failure, but read() only falls back to memory when getItem throws, so it keeps re-reading the old stored value. Repro: stub Storage.prototype.setItem to throw, press Add to bag -> badge 0, drawer empty, no 'won't be saved' note. Separately, a JSON parse error flips persistent=false forever, so the 'won't be saved' note shows even though storage works. Fix: once persistent is false, read() returns memory; treat parse errors as 'reset to []' without marking storage non-persistent.

title: Faded toast keeps intercepting taps over the drawer's Keep shopping button at 375 px
detail: .toast fades to opacity 0 but keeps z-index 80, its pointer events and its Undo button. Repro at 375x740: Remove a line, wait 5.6 s, tap the centre of Keep shopping -> elementFromPoint is the toast span; the drawer stays open. A tap on the invisible Undo would silently restore the removed item. Fix: .toast:not(.is-on){visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none} (visibility with a transition delay), and clear innerHTML after it hides.

title: Undo is unreachable by keyboard and screen-reader users while the bag drawer is open
detail: The Undo toast is outside the aria-modal drawer and the Tab trap only cycles inside the drawer. Probe: after Remove, Tab stops are only 'Shop crystals' and 'Close bag'. The spec (experience.md section 8) promises a forgiving 5 s Undo. Fix: render the undo row inside the drawer body (an inline 'Removed Amethyst · Undo' row where the line was), or mount the toast inside .drawer while it is open. Also stop the timer while the toast has focus or hover (WCAG 2.2.1).

title: Pay in person + Pay over time shows money 'due today' that nobody collects today
detail: Pickup + Pay in person + Over time -> button 'Place order · $23.75 today' and summary 'Due today $23.75', but in-person payment happens at pickup or delivery, so nothing is due today. A customer sees a charge-like promise that contradicts the 3c copy. Fix: when pay==='person', relabel to 'Pay $23.75 at pickup, then 3 payments of $23.75' (or disable over-time for in-person with a visible reason, like the shipping rule), and make the button 'Place order · pay at pickup'.

title: Checkout total goes stale when the bag changes in another tab; Place order charges the new amount
detail: The storage listener dispatches bag:external, but nothing listens for it (grep shows only the dispatch), so checkout's summary and button are not re-rendered. Repro: tab A checkout shows 'Place order · $16.00'; tab B adds a Citrine jar; tab A still shows $16.00, and submit re-syncs and places a $166.00 order. The customer agreed to one total and got another. Fix: in mount(), on storage events for mc.bag.v1 dispatch bag:change (drawer and checkout already re-render on it). In checkout's submit, compare the total shown with the recomputed total and stop with a 'Your bag changed' notice if they differ.

title: Catalogue strings interpolated into HTML without esc() (tags, slug, focus)
detail: c.tags go raw into the eyebrow, the tag chips (product.js:105, ui.js:388) and the data-tags/href attributes, as do slug and focus. These come from Melody's own data file, so this is not exploitable today, but one apostrophe or ampersand in a future tag breaks markup. Fix: wrap with esc() everywhere data reaches the HTML, matching the rest of the file.

title: Card checks are loose at the edges: 2220 is detected as Mastercard, expiry accepts 2099, debit copy says Visa/MC only but Amex passes
detail: The Mastercard 2-series regex 2(2[2-9]...) matches 2220 (the real range starts at 2221). checkExpiry accepts any YY, so 12/99 passes; real checkouts reject dates more than about 20 years out. The Debit card subtitle 'Visa or Mastercard debit' (checkout.js:14) contradicts the accepted brands. Fix: use ^(222[1-9]|22[3-9]\d|2[3-6]\d\d|27[01]\d|2720); reject years more than now+20; change the debit subtitle to 'Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover' or enforce it.

payment.js MC regex ^(5[1-5]|222[1-9]|22[3-9]\d|2[3-6]\d\d|27[01]\d|2720); expiry > now+20y = format; debit subtitle matches accepted brands; unit test 'review fixes'

title: Jar/bag 'format scenes' read as clip-art and cheapen the peak moment
where: product page / Select Jar / all viewports, light+dark
detail: Now: choosing Jar swaps the real 4:5 photo for a 560px SVG jar of ~12 identical photo-filled ellipses, each with the same stamped white highlight, plus a 'Melody's' label; copy says 'About 6 pieces'. Next to Commons photography it looks like a mock-up, at the exact moment the spec calls the peak. Should be: keep the crystal photo as the main image for every format, and show the scene as a <=140x175 'What you get' inset in the buy box under the tiles (or source real Commons photos of tumbled stones/jars). If kept anywhere: 6 stones to match copy, rx varied 22-36, drop the per-stone highlight ellipse, no label text. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-06-pdp-jar.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-dark-06-pdp-jar.jpg

title: Mobile product page: gallery overflows the right gutter (20px left, 3px right)
detail: Now: .gallery/.main mat/.thumbs right edge = 372px vs content edge 355px (probe: SECTION.gallery right 372, UL.thumbs 372); main photo and thumbs sit off-centre and the Jar thumb is clipped. Should be: symmetric 20px gutters; add min-width:0 to the .pdp grid children and let .thumbs scroll (overflow-x:auto) or shrink thumbs to 56x70 with gap 8 (5x56+4x8=312 <= 335). Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/m-light-05-pdp.jpg

title: Confirmation opens mid-scroll on mobile: 'Thank you, Ava!' and order number are off-screen
detail: Now: after Place order, scrollY=187 at 375 (33 at 1440); the ending moment opens on the recap card with the heading hidden under the header. Cause: checkout.js ~399-400 scrollTo({top:0}) runs smooth (html scroll-behavior:smooth) and is interrupted by .confirm.focus(). Should be: scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'instant'}) then focus({preventScroll:true}); scrollY must be 0. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/m-light-13-confirm.jpg

title: The 12 photos don't read as one set: black, grey, olive and beige backgrounds alternate
where: home #shop grid, hero trio / all viewports
detail: Now: 6 photos on black (Clear Quartz, Citrine, Selenite, Carnelian, Lapis, Fluorite), 3 on grey/white (Amethyst, Rose Quartz, Black Tourmaline), Smoky Quartz olive, Tiger's Eye beige; the 4-up grid reads as a checkerboard. Rose Quartz is soft/low detail with a dark strip at the frame bottom. Should be: one field. Re-source the 5 non-black photos with dark-background Commons alternates (target 12/12 dark), or tighten crops per crystal (focus + scale 1.15-1.3) so stone covers >=85% of the frame and background shows <15%. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-00-homefull.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-03-shop.jpg

title: Hero trio tilt and hover lift are dead: .rise animation fill overrides rotate()
detail: Now: Rose Quartz and Citrine sit dead straight; @keyframes rise ends at transform:none with fill-mode both, which beats .t2/.t3 rotate(-2deg/1.5deg) and the :hover translateY(-4px). Should be: keyframes from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px) rotate(var(--rot,0deg))} to{opacity:1;transform:rotate(var(--rot,0deg))}, or animation-fill-mode:backwards so hover works. Also Rose Quartz should overlap Amethyst by 24px (it currently starts 4px right of it). Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-01-home.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/t-light-01-home.jpg

title: Mobile first screen shows no crystal photography (trio starts at y=735 of 812)
detail: Now: only a 75px sliver of the trio is visible; §5 asks for the photo trio above the fold at 375. Should be: under 600px render the trio as a 3-up strip 112px tall placed between promise and buttons, or cut H1 to 2.5rem (4 to 3 lines) and tighten the stack (eyebrow rule margin 24 to 16, trust row to one line) so trio top <= 620. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/m-light-01-home.jpg

title: Desktop H1 stacks into a 5-line tower
detail: Now: 80px H1 in a ~460px column breaks into 5 lines (one or two words each), 430px tall. Should be: 3 lines; give text 6/12 (~580px) and cap h1 at clamp(2.75rem,5vw,4.25rem), or set max-width 11ch -> 13ch. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-01-home.jpg

title: Paired checkout fields drop out of alignment when error messages differ in height
detail: Now: Full name input sits 7px below Email (577 vs 570); Expiry 8px below CVC/Billing ZIP (764 vs 756), because .row-2/.row-3 bottom-align. Should be: align-items:start on .row-2/.row-3 so inputs share a top edge regardless of error length. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-11-errors.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-11b-card-errors.jpg

title: Order summary is not sticky: right column goes empty while filling the form
detail: Now: .summary is position:sticky but its wrapper .summary-col is exactly its height (358px), so it never sticks; from step 2 down the right half is blank and the total is out of sight. Should be: put the sticky on .summary-col (top: header-h + 24px, align-self:start) or let .summary-col stretch to the form height. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-10-ship-person.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-12-schedule.jpg

title: Price count-up shows a negative/garbage frame (−$2) and flickers on rapid switching
where: product buy box / format change; site/js/product.js:140-152 countTo
detail: Now: k=(t-t0)/220 is not clamped at 0; the rAF timestamp can precede performance.now() so e<0 and the first frame reads '−$2'. Rapid switching runs overlapping animations (sampled $6, $80, $21 ... when switching bag/jar). Should be: k=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(t-t0)/220)); keep one rAF id and cancel it before starting a new count. Evidence: probe log 'jar sync $16 | ... || −$2 | ...'

title: Confirmation totals break into three mismatched columns
detail: Now: Subtotal, Shipping and Total sit side by side as label/value pairs with different baselines (694 vs 713) and a rule only above Total; plan reads '4 payments of about $29.25 · $29.25 today' when the split is exact. Should be: stacked right-aligned rows matching the order summary (Subtotal, Shipping 'Free' with struck fee, rule, Total 1.25rem), and drop 'about' unless remainder cents exist. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-13-confirm.jpg

title: Console TypeError after confirmation when viewport crosses 1024px
where: checkout confirmation; site/js/checkout.js ~139 mq change listener -> renderSummary
detail: Now: after the order is placed, rotating a tablet/resizing fires the media-query listener, which writes to the removed [data-toggle-label]: 'Cannot set properties of null (setting textContent)'. No-Excuses test. Should be: register listeners with an AbortController and abort in showConfirmation. Evidence: probe4 'ERR at resize ... renderSummary ... setSummary ... MediaQueryList'

title: Restored filter (#shop?i=sleep) leaves the active chip scrolled out of view
detail: Now: status says '3 crystals for Sleep' but the visible chips show All/Calm/... none pressed; Sleep is off-screen in the horizontal row with no edge fade hinting more. Should be: on restore, activeChip.scrollIntoView({inline:'center',block:'nearest'}); add a 24px mask-image fade at the row's right edge. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/t-dark-04-sleep.jpg

title: Format tiles: selected check almost invisible and titles wrap unevenly at 1440
detail: Now: the 16px thin check is barely visible (esp. Jar tile, dark); 'Jar of big crystals' wraps to 2 lines so tile titles/sizes misalign; '2–3 cm' orphans 'cm'. Should be: check 20px white on a filled clay 20px circle at top-right; non-breaking spaces in all sizes ('2–3 cm'); title 1rem with tiles' price pinned to bottom (already) and sub-lines clamped to 2. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-05-pdp.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0004-melody-crystal-shop/evidence/polish-r1/d-light-06-pdp-jar.jpg

title: Small alignment slips: how-it-works cards vs step columns, line-item card edge, gift tile subtitle

detail: Now: format cards (gap 16) don't share the step grid (gap 32): card 1 ends 408 vs rule 398, card 2 starts 425 vs 431.
